name: Facebook Automation & SEO Studio
description: Production-grade Facebook automation engine for mobile and desktop: post publishing, scheduling, anti-duplicate protection, post re-edit/delete, and viral SEO generation.
author: Dipesh Kr Yadav

mcp_tools.name: fb_status
mcp_tools.description: Check Facebook bridge connectivity, SQLite queue status, and rate limit sentinels.

mcp_tools.name: fb_login_status
mcp_tools.description: Detect active Facebook profile, page, or group session from connected browser tab.

mcp_tools.name: fb_publish
mcp_tools.description: Publish a post (text, photo, video, reel) to Facebook with DOM verification.

media_paths.description: List of absolute file paths to photos or videos.

target_type.description: Where to publish (profile feed, managed page, group).

mcp_tools.name: fb_schedule
mcp_tools.description: Schedule a Facebook post for future publication via local scheduler.

run_at_timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp when the post should publish.

mcp_tools.name: fb_edit_post
mcp_tools.description: Re-edit an existing Facebook post caption via DOM menu automation.

post_url_or_id.description: URL or identifier of the post to edit.

new_caption.description: New caption text to replace the existing post content.

mcp_tools.name: fb_delete_post
mcp_tools.description: Delete a Facebook post or move it to trash via 3-dots menu automation.

post_url_or_id.description: URL or identifier of the post to delete.

mcp_tools.name: fb_list_posts
mcp_tools.description: List published, scheduled, or failed posts from local history database.

mcp_tools.name: fb_seo_generate
mcp_tools.description: Generate an algorithm-optimized viral Facebook post with hook, micro-bullets, CTA, hashtags, and first-comment link.

topic.description: Core subject or idea of the post.

link_url.description: Optional outbound link to place in first comment.

mcp_tools.name: fb_comments
mcp_tools.description: Post a comment (e.g. first comment with link) or reply on Facebook.

post_url_or_id.description: URL or identifier of the target post.

mcp_tools.name: fb_doctor
mcp_tools.description: Self-diagnose Facebook automation environment, bridge status, and guardrails.
